sql:
SELECT fish_date_doy AS doy, cls, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy>=75 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','day_1_5','hd_am','hd_pm')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
